start.text: It's contained. The message is stopped, but it is not gone.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. Forty inboxes still hold it, and Ravi's password is out there.
A.name: Carla

B.text: And a thief's computer is still signed in as Ravi.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. The inboxes, the password, then the sign-in.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Yes. Calmly, and with what to check: the sender and where the link goes. No panic, no blame.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Clean the inboxes, reset the key, sign the thief out, and tell the staff what to look for.
E.name: Joshua
